deja - persistent memory for coding agents

Usage:
  deja [flags] <query>
  deja search [flags] <query>   (same, but a query may start with a dash)
  deja show <id-prefix> [--json --harness name] [--offset n] [--limit n]
  deja share <id-prefix>
  deja resume <id-prefix> [--exec]
  deja wip [--json]
  deja handoff [--to <agent>] [id-prefix] [--exec]
  deja hook-prompt [--plain]  (UserPromptSubmit hook: relevance recall per prompt)
  deja hook-context [--plain] [--once] [--strict] [--notes]  (session start: the project digest, once per session)
  deja hook-antigravity (Antigravity PreInvocation hook: inject on first turn)
  deja hook-plan     (PreToolUse ExitPlanMode hook: factual plan/history co-occurrences)
  deja hook-tool [--plain] [--crush]  (PreToolUse Bash/Edit hook: one line on what this command or file already has)
  deja hook-tool-after  (PostToolUse Bash hook: the command that followed this error before)
  deja check -       (read a plan from stdin and print factual co-occurrences)
  deja view [--no-open]  (browse your memory: sessions, recalls, notes — one local HTML)
  deja ctx <query|id-prefix>
  deja blame <path>[:line] [--all] [--json] [--project name] [--harness name] [--since 30d]
  deja blame <path>:<line> --attribution [--json] [--git-note]  (the line answer alone)
  deja files <topic> [--project name] [--all-projects] [--limit n] [--json]
  deja restore <path> [--span n] [-o|--out file] [--force]
  deja friction [--limit n] [--json]
  deja secrets [--limit n] [--json] [--scrub [--dry-run]]  (credentials your agent transcripts are carrying; --scrub rewrites the files that hold one)
  deja tests [--limit n] [--json]    (your build and test runs, week by week)
  deja recap [--since 7d] [--limit n] [--json]  (what the week settled, with the session behind each line)
  deja fix "<error text>" [--limit n] [--json]  (what was run after this error before)
  deja how <what> [--project name] [--all-projects] [--limit n] [--json]
             (commands this project actually ran; --all-projects for the machine)
  deja sync export <dir> [--full] [--include-imported] [--peer name]
  deja sync import <dir>
  deja sync                       (exchange with every machine deja knows, both ways)
  deja sync ssh <host> [--pull] [--both] [--full]
  deja sync forget <host>
  deja last [n] [--json] [--project name] [--harness name] [--from machine|local] [--since duration] [--role user|assistant|tool|files|command|edit|summary]
  deja sources
  deja completion <bash|zsh|fish|powershell>
  deja forget --session <id-prefix> [--project <substring>] [--before <duration|date>] [--dry-run] [--all-matches]
  deja forget --list | --unforget <id>
  deja doctor [--json] [--deep] [--offline]
  deja warmup
  deja index [--rebuild] [--quiet]
  deja embed
  deja bench recall|context|prompt|block|ingest|read [--json] [--seed n]
  deja brief         (the screen a bare deja prints on a terminal)
  deja log [n] [--last] [--json]
  deja statusline
  deja stats [--json] [--impact] [--year] [--redaction] [--card [path]] [--html [path]]
             [--project name] [--harness name] [--since 30d] [--role name]
  deja remember "text" [--project name] [--tag name]
  deja promote <id-prefix> [--state accepted|rejected|superseded|stale] [--note "text"] [--tag name] [--to path]
  deja mcp
  deja version
  deja <command> --help
  deja update [--force]
  deja install <target>... | --all | --auto  [--no-guidance] [--no-index]
  deja uninstall <target>... | --all | --auto
    targets:
      claude-code, claude-auto, codex, codex-auto, opencode, opencode-auto,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regenerates the centralized credential environment for the LXC.

Outputs (all chmod 644 — world-readable, no blocks):
  /etc/study-agent/env.sh        — canonical source of truth (POSIX shell)
  /etc/study-agent/ENVMAP.md     — map: service → var → source
  /etc/profile.d/study-agent.sh  — auto-source for any login shell
  /etc/bash.bashrc               — auto-source for non-login interactive bash
  data/config-backup/env.sh      — symlink → /etc/study-agent/env.sh (user entry point)
  data/config-backup/ENVMAP.md   — symlink → /etc/study-agent/ENVMAP.md

Idempotent. Re-run after changing any source credential.

Usage:
    sudo python3 data/config-backup/build-env.py
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import json
import os
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

SHARED = Path("/etc/study-agent")
SHARED_ENV = SHARED / "env.sh"
SHARED_MAP = SHARED / "ENVMAP.md"
SHARED_PROFILE_D = Path("/etc/profile.d/study-agent.sh")
ETC_BASHRC = Path("/etc/bash.bashrc")
USER_DIR = ROOT / "data" / "config-backup"

# config-backup

Backup criptografado das configs sensíveis do **OpenCode CLI**, **OpenWork Desktop** e do **Kairos (TickTick OAuth)** do Willian.
Esse diretório vive dentro do repo `data/` (git em `github.com/willianmendesf/data.git`, privado).
O conteúdo está em `.secret/credentials.tar.gpg` — cifrado com **GPG simétrico AES-256**.

## Por que existe?

Para que em outra máquina dê pra rodar:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/willianmendesf/data.git
cd data/config-backup
./restore.sh
# → cola a senha GPG quando pedir
# → em 1 minuto: providers, MCPs, zlibs, tokens, .env do Kairos (TickTick) — tudo de volta
```

Sem isso, seria recadastrar uma por uma nos dialogs do OpenWork/Claude — chato e propenso a erro.

## O que tem dentro?

Cifrado (14 arquivos, ~19 KB):

### OpenCode CLI (`~/.config/opencode/`)

| Arquivo original | Conteúdo |
|---|---|
| `opencode.json` | providers AI (OpenCode, DeepSeek, MiniMax, OpenAI, OpenRouter) com API keys + 4 zlibs MCP + openwork-cloud MCP + playwright/gdrive/ticktick |
| `opencode.jsonc` | overrides de providers |
| `.gitignore` | exclusões do opencode |

### OpenWork Desktop

| Arquivo original | Conteúdo |
|---|---|
| `~/.config/com.differentai.openwork/openwork-server-tokens.json` | owner/host/client tokens do servidor OpenWork |
| `~/.config/openwork/tokens.json` | id e hash do desktop owner token |
| `~/.config/openwork/env.json` | variáveis `LPR_*_API_KEY` (versão OpenWork) |
| `~/.config/openwork/runtime-opencode-config.json` | runtime state (51 KB) |

### Google Drive MCP (`~/.config/gdrive-mcp/`)

| Arquivo original | Conteúdo |
|---|---|
| `gcp-oauth.keys.json` | OAuth client keys do Google (criadas em Google Cloud Console) |
| `gcp-oauth.keys.json.bak.1789647334` | backup automático (mesma chave) |
| `gdrive-credentials.json` | tokens de acesso após auth OAuth |
| `gdrive-credentials.json.bak.1789640583` | backup automático do credentials |

### Z-Library MCP — 4 contas (`~/.zlib-mcp/` + `data/perfil/bibliotecario/`)

| Arquivo original | Conteúdo |
|---|---|
| `~/.zlib-mcp/credentials.json` | remix_id + remix_key das 4 contas zlib (zlib/zlib2/zlib3/zlib4) |
| `data/perfil/bibliotecario/zlib-credentials.yaml` | email/senha como fallback (login automático) + audit (alias, datas, observações) |

### Kairos — credenciais TickTick (vive dentro do study-agent)

| Arquivo original | Conteúdo |
|---|---|
| `<study-agent>/data/perfil/kairos/.env` | `TICKTICK_CLIENT_ID`, `TICKTICK_CLIENT_SECRET`, `TICKTICK_ACCESS_TOKEN`, `TICKTICK_REFRESH_TOKEN`, `TICKTICK_TOKEN_EXPIRES_AT`, e URLs |

### Plugin do deja-vu (arquivo PLANO, fora do tar cifrado)

| Arquivo aqui | Restaurado em | Conteúdo |
|---|---|---|
| `dot-config/opencode/plugins/deja.js` | `~/.config/opencode/plugins/deja.js` | Plugin de recall automático de memória entre sessões, **com ajustes locais** (emptyRetries 3→6; digest com TTL de 10 min). Não tem segredo — por isso fica em texto plano. |

O `restore.sh` copia esse arquivo (fazendo backup do atual antes). Um
`deja install opencode-auto` posterior sobrescreve com a versão padrão — restaurar
de novo a partir daqui.

### Memos — servidor pessoal do Will (arquivo PLANO, fora do tar cifrado)

| Arquivo aqui | Conteúdo |
|---|---|
| `memos/memos.env` | `MEMOS_URL` (pública) + `MEMOS_PAT` (PAT pessoal). chmod 600. URL é pública; PAT é tratado como segredo mesmo sendo single-user. Rotação: Memos → Settings → My Access Tokens → Revoke + criar novo. |
